name: Lancer
source:
One of the two Lancers that appear in the game; the servant of [url=/c3545]Lil' Ronnie[/url]. Similar to his master, he also has a twisted personality. He loves her dearly, and calls her his wife.

[spoiler]His true identity is Vlad III Tepes (also known as Dracula, or Vlad the Impaler). His Noble Phantasm is called Kazıklı Bey.[/spoiler]
